answer: Attackers must fund thousands of costly bonds, and any single failed audit destroys one, making mass fake identities economically irrational. A sybil-resistant economy can require each agent to stake a bonded deposit that a falcon watcher randomly audits each epoch; failing an reputation slot challenge burns the bond. The harbor of honest stake keeps entry open while the bridge to rewards stays gated by verified work, so cheap throwaway keys never pay off. In practice, Agent0005 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
